newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to invite three on Sept 2 to buy MHB bank.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to invite three on Sept 2 to buy MHB bank.

text.p: Hungary will offer a stake in Magyar Hitel Bank (MBH) to three long-term investors on September 2, the state privatisation agency APV was quoted by MTI news agency as saying on Wednesday.
APV said the three bidders it will invite should submit their bids within 45 days from September 2, but did not identify them.
MHB, Hungary's fifth largest bank by assets, has a registered capital of 7.15 billion forints.

Press reports said earlier that Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein CABV-pa.VI and Bank Austria OESV-p.VI, the Dutch ABN Amro Bank NV and ING Bank and Citicorp of the United States were interested to buy a controlling stake in MHB.
The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and the World Bank subsidiary International Finance Corp may also buy smaller stakes in MHB, press reports added.
APV planned to sell 89.23 percent of MHB to large investors and five percent to MHB employees and managers, MTI said. -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 266 2410
